notes.title: Version 1.2 released
notes.content:
Version 1.2 is now available!

Updated contents
- Implemented stage-specific background music (BGM)
- Adjusted sound effects (SE) and BGM volume balance
- Fixed issues where text was cut off in translations

notes.title: Version 1.1 released
notes.content:

notes.title: Version 1.1 update notice
notes.content:
